content: Qornoloosanne Phexroosa
Qisaariya geetettiza deren, «Xaalaane wottadarata» geetettiza ola asaa garsan mato halaqa Qornoloosa geetettizayssi dees.
Izikka ba keeththa asaa kumeththaara Ayana hanon minonne Xoos babbizaade; manqotaska daro muxuwaata immizaadenne daro wode Xoos woossiza asa.
Issi gallas gallassafe uddufun saate bolla Xoossa kiitanchchay izas ajjuutan beettidi izakko yiidi, «Qornoloosaa!» gi xeygishin qonccen be7ides.
Qornoloosikka dagamara tishshi histti xeellishe, «Godoo hayssi aazee?» gides. Kiitanchchayka zaaridi, «Ne woosaynne ne muxuwaatay qofettanaas pude Xoossa sinth gakkides.
Ne ha7i as Iyophphe yeddada Phexroosa geetettiza Simoona xeygisa.
Izikka abba matan diza galba qaaciza Simoonason imaththateth dees» gides.
Qornoloosa haasayssida kiitanchchay izappe shaakettidi bidaappe guye ba ashkaratappe nam7ata qasse Ayana yo7os minonne izas daro ammanettiza wottadaratappe issaa xeygisidi,
izi be7idayssa ubbaa isttas yootidi Iyophphe kiittides.
Phexroosi Be7ida Ajjuuta
Kiitettida asati wonteththa gallas gede katamaykko matishin Phexroosi usuppun saate bolla woossana pude Pooqe bolla kezides.
He wode izi gafida gishshas qumay buro kaxxishin dhisko mala liphiphi histtiin ajjuutara saloy doyettiin issi gita xaaxettida may7o malay oyddu baggara oykettidi duge biittan wodhdhishin be7ides.
He may7oza bolla oyddu tohoy diza dumma dumma do7ati biittara gooshettiza medheteththatinne salo bolla piradhdhiza kafoti deettes.
He wode, «Phexroosa denda hayta shukkada ma!» giza qaala siyides.
Phexroosi qasse, «Godoo hayssi hanenna! Geesh gidonttayssa woykko tuna miish ta mulerakka ma erikke» gides.
He kase qaalay qasseka nam7anththo izakko yiidi, «Xoossi geeshshidayssa ne tuna mala qoodoppa» gides.
Hessika heedzdzuto shiretti shiretti izakko yidaappe guye may7o misatizayssi heerakka pude salo bides.
Phexroosikka ba be7ida ajjuutaza birsheththaa eranaas daro metotidi keehi qofa bolla dishin Qornoloosi kiittida asati Simoona keeththe koyishe demmidi pengen eqqida.
Qaala dhoqqu histtidi, «Phexroosa geetettiza Simooni dizasoy hayssan awanee?» gi oychchida.
Phexroosi ba be7idayssa keehi qoppishin Xillo Ayanay iza, «Hekko heedzdzu asati nena koyeettes; denda! Duge wodhdhada istta yeddiday tana gidida gishshas sidhey baynda isttara ba» gides.
Phexroosikka duge wodhdhidi, «Hekko intte koyzaadey tanakko! Intte yiday aazassee?» gides.

Isttika izas, «Nuni mato halaqa Qornoloosa matappe yidos; izikka Xoossas babbiza xillo asanne Ayhuda asa ubbaa matan daro bonchchettida asa; nekka iza soo baana malanne ne gizayssa izi siyana mala geeshsha kiitanchchay izas yootides» gida.
Phexroosikka asata ba dizason mokki ekkidi ayssides. Qornoloosa Keeththan Phexroosa Phexroosikka wonteththa gallas dendidi isttara bides; Iyophphefe yida issi issi ammaniza asati izara issife bida.
Qornoloosikka ba dabbotanne mata laggeta ba soon shiishshidi naago bolla dishin izi nam7anththo gallas Qisaariya gakkides.
Phexroosikka Qornoloosa keeththe geliin Qornoloosi iza mokki ekkidi iza toho bolla hokki goynnides.
Gido attiin Phexroosi, «Tanikka ne mala asakko! Denda» giidi denththides.
Phexroosikka iza haasayssishe izara soo gelishin daro derey shiiqi uttidayssa be7ides.

Izikka isttas, «Ayhuda asi hara dere asara gaaggontta mala woykko hara dere as gididayta mata shiiqontta mala nu wogay diggizayssa intte ereeta; gido attiin ta oonakka tuna woykko izi geesh deenna gontta mala Xoossi taas qonccisides.
Hessa gishshas ta xeygettida wode hekko sidhontta yadis; histtiin intte tana aazas xeygidaakko erana koyays» gides.
Qornoloosikka, «Oyddu gallassafe kase likke hanni wode gallassaafe uddufun saaten tani tason woossishin qoppontta booththa may7o may7ida asi yiidi ta sinththan eqqidi
tana, ‹Qornoloosaa! Ne woosay siyettides; ne manqotas immiza muxuwaatay Xoossa sinth gakkides.
Hessa gishshas Iyophphe katama as kiittada Phexroosa geetettiza Simoona ehisa; izi abba achchan galba qaaciza Simoona keeththan imaththateth dees› gides.
Tanikka heerakka neekko as kiittadis; ne yuussayka lo7o; histtiko Goday nena azazidayssa ne nuus yootikko Xoossi yootidayssa neeppe siyanaas nu wurikka hayssan Xoossa sinththan doos» gides.
Phexroosikka, «Xoossi oonakka shaakki maaddonttayssa tumappe ta eradis.
Gido attiin Xoossas babbizaytanne xillo ooththizayta ubbaa oona baggafe gidiinkka izi ekkees.
Xoossi ubbaas Godaa gidida Yesus Kirstoosa baggara Isra7eele asas kiittida saroteththa Mishiraachcho kiitay hayssa.
Yohannisi xinqata gishshas sabbakidaappe guye Galilappe doommidi kumeththa Yuhudan hanidayssa intte ereeta.
Xoossi Naazirete Yesusa Xillo Ayananinne wolqqan tiydes; izikka Xoossi izara diza gishshas ba gakkidason ubbaan lo7o ooththishe Xala7e godateththa giddon dizayta ubbaa paththides.
«Izi Ayhudata dereninne Yerusalaame kataman ooththidayssa ubbaas nu markka; qasseka asay iza miththa bolla kaqqi wodhides.
Gido attiin Xoossi iza heedzdzanththo gallas hayqoppe denththidessinne asi iza beyana mala ooththides.
Izi qoncciday asa ubbaas gidontta hayqoppe dendiin izara midaytassinne izara uyidaytas Xoossi koyro doorida nuus iza markkatassa.
Izi nu derezas sabbakana malanne hayqqidayta bollanne paxa dizayta bolla pirdanaas Xoossi shuumiday iza gididayssa nu markkattana mala nuna azazides.
Iza ammanidaadey wuri iza sunththan nagara maarettidi geeyanayssa nabeti izas markkatteettes» gi yooto doommides.
Phexroosi hessa haasayshin qaalaa siyizayta ubbaa bolla Xillo Ayanay wodhdhides.
Qaxxarettidayta baggafe Phexroosara yida ammanizayti Xillo Ayana imoteththi Ayzaabeta bolla wodhdhishin be7idi malalettida.
Hessika istti dumma qaalan haasayshininne Xoossa galatishin siyida gishshassa. He wode Phexroosi,
«Hayti asati nu mala Xillo Ayana ekkida gishshas istti haaththan xammaqettontta mala istta digganay oonee?» gides.
Hessa gishshas Yesus Kirstoosa sunththan xammaqettana mala azazides; hessafe guye Phexroosi guuththa wode isttara daana mala woossida.
